jobs.prompt: House-tour photograph of the front entrance of an ordinary single-storey family home in a quiet Mediterranean suburb, 16:9. The camera stands on the front garden path at eye height 1.2 m, 24 mm lens, perfectly level, verticals straight, everything sharp, looking straight into a small covered entrance porch about 3 m wide and 3.5 m deep that fills the frame edge to edge: its two side walls, its back wall, and its flat plaster ceiling at normal room height, seen only as a thin pale band at the top centre. The walls are warm bone limewash plaster (#ECE5DA) with a soft hand-trowelled texture and gently rounded inside corners; the floor is large honed pale limestone slabs (#D8C8AE), continuing out as the path under the camera. In the back wall, on the left third of the frame, the front door: a normal single house door, about 1 m wide and 2.4 m high, about a third of the wall's width, with plain wall above it up to the ceiling. The top of the door opening is a simple half-circle and the door fills it exactly. The leaf is flush matte-oiled walnut (#6B4A33) with vertical grain and a slim vertical dark-bronze bar pull, set straight into the plaster in a plain rounded reveal. Just right of the door, one small cylindrical dark-bronze wall light, switched on, glowing warm up and down the plaster. Low, warm winter-afternoon sun from behind-left lights the lower half of the right-hand wall, printed with the soft, lacy shadow of olive leaves; the back wall and the door are in soft, even shade. In the left foreground, cut by the frame edge, the gnarled silver-grey trunk of one old olive tree growing in the garden beside the path, a few grey-green branches crossing the top-left corner in front of the plaster. On the left side wall near the back corner, in shade, a narrow fluted-glass window in a slim dark-bronze frame. Calm, warm, lived-in, human scale. Nothing else: no niche, portal or frame around the door, no curved or wavy walls, no water feature, no light strips, no pots, no furniture, no doormat, no house number, no text, no people.
